description: Verify that the receiver TCP checks the checksum and acknowledges in case of no error (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.7 p86)
approach:
[Objective]
Positive baseline for TCP checksum: a well-formed segment must be acked. Anchors CHECKSUM_02's negative case.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment with correct checksum.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK.

[Pass condition]
DUT acks the correct-checksum data.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_data_ack — DUT did not ack correct-checksum data

verdicts.Fail_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to correct-checksum data
